title: codex_dispatch_input
description: Documentation-only schema for the conceptual input payload to plan_codex_dispatch.py. The Codex wrapper currently accepts CLI argparse args directly rather than a single JSON envelope; this schema exists to declare the cross-wrapper contract for fields that span all three dispatch wrappers (TASK-002 of PLAN_WRAPPER_REVERT_POLICY_GATE).

unattended_revert_policy.description: Cross-references the orchestrator-level --unattended-revert-policy flag (PLAN_WRAPPER_REVERT_POLICY_GATE). Optional: when omitted the wrapper defaults to the safer-by-default 'pause' behavior. The orchestrator pins this via Phase 0 preflight and propagates it via the $UNATTENDED_REVERT_POLICY env var or the --unattended-revert-policy CLI arg.
